l.x: Ride south-east to the Altar of Zul, the stepped Vilebranch temple in the south of the Les Hinterlands, and climb to the top. Qiaga and Morta'gya la Gardienne (elite, 50) stand up there: touch the top and come straight back down. Careful: Elite trolls guard the top platform, including Qiaga la Gardienne and Morta'gya la Gardienne, along with several Vilebranch Soothsayers. The soothsayers cast spells and are linked to the rest of the group.

h: Terres foudroyées: kill these as you meet them

l.x: Ride west: Starving Snickerfangs roam the dry hills just south of the bloodmages' camp; Scorpok Stingers (level 50) scuttle across the middle of the north. Pourfendeur noir vultures circle over all of it. Pull one at a time. Ashmane Boars and Redstone Basilisks share the slopes south-west of the keep. Keep clear of the Helboars further south: they are level 52. Careful: Scorpok Stingers use Venom Sting; Clack le Ravageur adds Knockdown.
